# Summary
Verify one Clear402 PaymentContext EIP-712 message_sign pact on SETH.

# Operations
- If owner approval activates this pact, sign one allow-shaped PaymentContext typed-data message.
- Attempt one deny-shaped PaymentContext typed-data message with mismatched domain/hash for policy denial evidence.

# Risk Controls
- message_sign only; no transfers or contract calls.
- Chain restricted to SETH and source address restricted to the current CAW wallet address.
- EIP-712 domain, primary type, paymentContextHash, and intent are exact-match allowlist conditions.
- Request-count limit set to two signing requests per rolling 24h window for this verification.
